arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction whose internal ID is a multiple of 100, which gives a fixed 1% sample for manual review. The same transactions are flagged every time, so it is a deterministic stand-in for a random pick.
assumptions: random() is not allowed in a rule, so the 1% sample is taken by transaction id modulo 100 instead of a true random draw.
The sample is 1% of transactions by id, not of any particular segment, card or time period.
Transaction ids are assumed to be spread evenly enough that the sample comes out close to 1%.
